description: Looked once, failed to see the crowd, and went up to the truckle.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Set Alse into her chamber, barred the street door, and forbade a light in the front.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Lay along the Golding and was not shifted.
name: Gib

description: Went to the garret without a word, and stayed out of the lane.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Passed to his own door and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Counted three heads, noted Sir John's silence, and asked what tomorrow is.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Stood where the door, the bar, and the one candle were all in view.
name: William Shakespeare
